attchmntText: S H Kelkar and Company Limited has informed the Exchange about Newspaper Publication in respect of Postal Ballot Notice
sm_name: S H Kelkar and Company Limited
voiceSummary: Welspun Enterprises Limited published newspaper advertisements on November 07, 2026, regarding a Postal Ballot Notice. The company seeks shareholder approval via remote e-voting. The voting period runs from November 07, 2026, at 9:00 A.M. IST to December 06, 2026, at 5:00 P.M. IST. Mr. Mihen Halani is the appointed Scrutinizer. Results are expected by December 08, 2026. S H Kelkar and Company Limited also published advertisements for a Postal Ballot. The resolutions include re-appointment of Ms. Neela Bhattacherjee as Independent Director and appointment of Ms. Sumedha Karmarkar as Non-Executive Non-Independent Director. Voting is open from November 09, 2026, to December 08, 2026. Mr. Sachin Sharma is the Scrutinizer. Results are due by December 10, 2026. Transworld Shipping Lines Limited approved unaudited financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. Trio Mercantile and Trading Limited reported standalone financial results for the quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026.
